scope: 8 minutes from the same three NBHL recordings; development model comparison.
method_summary: Terra 6.1 scans chronological 20-second windows at 1.875 fps, then re-examines its own proposed attempts with full views at 2.5 fps, native goal crops at 7.5 fps and up to 30 seconds of aftermath. The shot-counting rules are frozen from the Astra experiment. No Astra event answers are supplied to this pipeline.
review_summary: These are experimental model predictions on previously examined development clips. Agreement with Astra is not ground truth. The existing three New Jersey goals provide a limited sanity check; SOG precision and recall remain unmeasured.
definition: SOG = a legal attacking shot, tip, or deflection that scores or would enter the goal if not stopped by the goalkeeper. Exclude wide/high attempts, post/crossbar-only attempts, skater blocks, harmless passes, goalie collection of wide balls, and disallowed goals. Count a distinct rebound shot separately. Unknown outcome or on-target path is not confirmed SOG.
cost_scope: Pipeline cost includes Terra scan and its own context pass. Matched-context and max experiments are additional evaluation expense, not pipeline cost. Conservative estimates include unresolved reservations and a 25% input-rate margin. Standard-rate totals are recomputed from reported ordinary input, cache reads and cache writes, using the default 30-minute cache-write rate when no lifetime breakdown is supplied. The raw ledger standard_rate_usd field is a legacy base-rate estimate that omits cache-write premiums; do not use it as billed cost. Neither estimate is an invoice. Modal compute/storage is excluded.

goal_sanity_check.meaning: Sanity check only: official goal events with previously assistant-reviewed video timing, using a2-second tolerance. These are development recordings. This does not measure save accuracy or full SOG precision/recall.

proposed_goal_sanity_check.meaning: Development diagnostic: match any predicted goal outcome before confidence/evidence counting rules. This does not make withheld goals counted SOG, and does not establish accuracy or recall.

paired_completed_context_cost_and_latenc.meaning: Same prompt, source frames, crops, sampling and reasoning/output settings; only requests completed by both original context passes. Timing excludes frame preparation and token-count requests. Separate, non-simultaneous runs; this is not a controlled latency benchmark.

matched-context.meaning: Prediction agreement, not accuracy. Maximum one-to-one timing alignment within the same team and clip; outcomes are not used to pick matches.

own-context.meaning: Prediction agreement, not accuracy. Maximum one-to-one timing alignment within the same team and clip; outcomes are not used to pick matches.

baseline_sog_within_terra_proposal_cores.meaning: Whether each Astra-estimated SOG release falls within a Terra review core; proposal coverage of another model’s predictions, not shot recall.

baseline_comparison_note: Astra campaign includes its earlier strict verification and recovery experiments; its scan+context+recovery subtotal omits verification expense although one window used verifier fallback. Terra matched-context uses Astra proposals for a controlled diagnostic, not independent discovery.
limitations: No independent human SOG labels, precision or recall.
More counted events or agreement with Astra does not establish higher accuracy.
Initial scanning can miss attempts. Failed windows are missing, not zero.
Counts are estimates and shooter identities remain unverified.
Matched-context reuses Astra proposals; only own-context tests independent Terra discovery.
No ball/player tracking costs are included.

max_reasoning_diagnostic.scope: Additional development diagnostic after reading high-reasoning results. All nine frozen Astra windows containing its twelve estimated SOG; not independent discovery, ground truth or a full-game maximum-reasoning pipeline.

max_reasoning_diagnostic.note: Added after examining high-reasoning outputs. Maximum reasoning and an increased output allowance are changed together. Initial max calls allow 16384 tokens; known token-limited responses can receive a separately versioned 65536-token recovery with a 900-second timeout. Both costs remain included. Conditional development diagnostic, not a fresh accuracy test or a measured maximum-reasoning full pipeline.
